subject: Head 633c75be revalidation: Alpha2 hotfix CI failed; early-wake implementation remains experimental
body: Revalidated lane against current main 633c75be26001d5a4ef6e04c7696e8246713be44. Repository app source blobs for DuoShellService/Fold7ContinuityCoordinator remain the 699ed baseline; the new runtime behavior exists in GEN6_BETA_HOTFIX_V1 patcher applied only in CI workspace. Workflow run 37040797908 completed FAILURE: package validation + patch application PASS; compileFullDebugKotlin PASS; testFullDebugUnitTest FAIL 108 tests / 1 failure; no APK artifact. Exact failure: Fold7AngleAuthorityTest.coarsePublicRemainsShadowOnlyAfterPreciseExpiry line 29 assertTrue(expired.stateChanged). Root source interaction: patched promotePublic(coarse) sets currentSource=NONE and returns stateChanged=true/dropReason, but existing expirePrecise then discards that Decision when output==null, recomputes changed from already-NONE as false, and returns a fresh Decision without dropReason. Early-wake review of the same hotfix: it now attempts logical inner route enable + unconditional requestDisplayPower(...STATE_ON), but still lacks immutable openingAttempt/serviceEpoch cancellation fencing, native/default early-stop, ambiguity/default-ownership rechecks, FIRST_USEFUL/FIRST_INTERACTIVE receipts, and platform proof that STATE_ON is a valid force-on contract. Top-level ok remains physicalPowered, so logical failure can coexist with ok=true. This supersedes the old 699ed source-only conclusion but preserves the field baseline: +165ms physical wake vs +1234ms first proven inner logical active/default. No production writes.
